annotations.title: x402 Service Finder (Which API Should I Call?)

description: Find the right paid API for a task across the whole x402 market, not only agentsvc.io: describe what your agent needs in plain words ("convert a web page to markdown", "token price on Solana", "transcribe audio") and get the best matching x402 endpoints from about 45,000 listed ones, each with provider, URL, method, price in USD, payment networks, an input hint, and whether it answered our own check with a valid 402 (reachable, checked_at, response time). Ranked by text match, repeat purchases and reachability, at most 3 per provider, no boost for agentsvc.io. Filter by max_price_usd and network. Index refreshed daily. Price: $0.005 USDC per call, paid inside this MCP call via x402 (USDC on Base, Solana, Polygon or Arbitrum). x402 MCP clients such as @x402/mcp pay automatically. Free sample: call with the example input {"task":"convert a web page to markdown","limit":5}.

include_unreachable.description: Also return endpoints that failed our last check

max_price_usd.description: Only endpoints at or below this price per call

network.description: Only endpoints that accept payment on this network

task.description: What your agent needs, in plain words
